title: Declared WCS Solution (when present)
description: Astrometric World Coordinate System parameters supplied by the caller. Never invented. Pixel origin matches detection centroids (0-based image pixels). Absent or incomplete WCS must fail closed — callers must not invent CRVAL/CD.

crpix.description: Reference pixel (x, y) in the same 0-based pixel grid as detection centroids

crval_deg.description: Sky coordinates at CRPIX as [ra_deg, dec_deg]

cd_deg_per_pixel.description: 2x2 CD matrix in degrees per pixel: [[cd1_1, cd1_2], [cd2_1, cd2_2]] mapping (dx, dy) to (dra, ddec) in a local linear approximation

source_reference.description: Optional citation for the WCS provenance (FITS header hash, plate-solve receipt, etc.)
